001package models;
002
003import java.io.Serializable;
004
005/**
006 * Grade record for a student in a course (two attempts plus final exam).
007 */
008public class Mark implements Serializable {
009    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
010
011    private int att1;
012    private int att2;
013    private int finalExam;
014    private Student student;
015    private Course course;
016
017    public Mark(int att1, int att2, int finalExam, Student student, Course course) {
018        this.att1 = att1;
019        this.att2 = att2;
020        this.finalExam = finalExam;
021        this.student = student;
022        this.course = course;
023    }
024
025    public int getAtt1() {
026        return att1;
027    }
028
029    public int getAtt2() {
030        return att2;
031    }
032
033    public int getFinalExam() {
034        return finalExam;
035    }
036
037    public Student getStudent() {
038        return student;
039    }
040
041    public Course getCourse() {
042        return course;
043    }
044
045    public int getTotal() {
046        return att1 + att2 + finalExam;
047    }
048
049    public String getLetterGrade() {
050        int total = getTotal();
051        if (total >= 90) return "A";
052        if (total >= 80) return "B";
053        if (total >= 70) return "C";
054        if (total >= 60) return "D";
055        return "F";
056    }
057
058    public boolean isPassed() {
059        return getTotal() >= 60;
060    }
061
062    @Override
063    public String toString() {
064        return "Mark{" +
065                "student=" + (student == null ? "-" : student.getLogin()) +
066                ", course=" + (course == null ? "-" : course.getCourseID()) +
067                ", att1=" + att1 +
068                ", att2=" + att2 +
069                ", finalExam=" + finalExam +
070                ", total=" + getTotal() +
071                ", letter='" + getLetterGrade() + '\'' +
072                ", passed=" + isPassed() +
073                '}';
074    }
075}
